scope: Paired development primitives, not complete OwnerPlan, held-out tasks or owner acceptance. Five candidate and five baseline meetings on three same-setting cases, 45 stages, zero repairs. Correct quotations/native validity and distinct wording do not prove sound interpretation. Candidate has six calls versus three baseline; timings are descriptive on a shared machine, not an independence-only speed result. Partial usefulness is preserved in notes; zero complete gate passes does not mean every sentence was useless. No overall baseline/full-team competence percentage inferred.
